cases.name: every dev skill is present: name, a one-line plain description, argument-hint, disable-model-invocation true
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; fm() { awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---" {exit} NR>1 && $0=="---" {exit} NR>1' "$1"; }; desc_ok() { d=$(fm "$1" | sed -n 's/^description: //p'); [ "$(fm "$1" | grep -c '^description:')" = 1 ] && [ -n "$d" ] && case "$d" in '"'*|"'"*|*': '*|*' #'*) false ;; *) true ;; esac; }; n=0; for s in dev-spec dev-plan dev-implement dev-verify dev-unit-tests dev-integration-tests dev-learn; do f="$P/dev/claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md"; n=$((n+1)); [ -f "$f" ] || { printf 'BAD-missing:%s ' "$s"; continue; }; fm "$f" | grep -qx "name: $s" || printf 'BAD-name:%s ' "$s"; desc_ok "$f" || printf 'BAD-description:%s ' "$s"; fm "$f" | grep -q '^argument-hint: ' || printf 'BAD-hint:%s ' "$s"; fm "$f" | grep -qx 'disable-model-invocation: true' || printf 'BAD-invocable:%s ' "$s"; done; [ "$n" = 7 ] || printf 'BAD-count:%s ' "$n"; printf 'ok'

cases.name: every dev skill body stays lean: 80 lines at most after the front matter
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; for s in dev-spec dev-plan dev-implement dev-verify dev-unit-tests dev-integration-tests dev-learn; do f="$P/dev/claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md"; b=$(awk 'n>=2; /^---$/ {n++}' "$f" | wc -l); [ "$b" -le 80 ] || printf 'BAD-long:%s=%s ' "$s" "$b"; done; printf 'ok'

cases.name: every dev agent is present: name, a one-line plain description, tools, model, maxTurns, effort
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; fm() { awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---" {exit} NR>1 && $0=="---" {exit} NR>1' "$1"; }; desc_ok() { d=$(fm "$1" | sed -n 's/^description: //p'); [ "$(fm "$1" | grep -c '^description:')" = 1 ] && [ -n "$d" ] && case "$d" in '"'*|"'"*|*': '*|*' #'*) false ;; *) true ;; esac; }; n=0; for a in dev-test-author dev-implementer dev-auditor adversarial-reviewer; do f="$P/dev/claude/agents/$a.md"; n=$((n+1)); [ -f "$f" ] || { printf 'BAD-missing:%s ' "$a"; continue; }; fm "$f" | grep -qx "name: $a" || printf 'BAD-name:%s ' "$a"; desc_ok "$f" || printf 'BAD-description:%s ' "$a"; for k in tools model maxTurns effort; do fm "$f" | grep -qE "^$k: [^ ]" || printf 'BAD-%s:%s ' "$k" "$a"; done; done; [ "$n" = 4 ] || printf 'BAD-count:%s ' "$n"; printf 'ok'

cases.name: the read-only agents (dev-auditor, adversarial-reviewer) have neither Write nor Edit, and disallow both
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; fm() { awk 'NR==1 && $0!="---" {exit} NR>1 && $0=="---" {exit} NR>1' "$1"; }; for a in dev-auditor adversarial-reviewer; do f="$P/dev/claude/agents/$a.md"; fm "$f" | sed -n 's/^tools: //p' | grep -qwE 'Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit' && printf 'BAD-writes:%s ' "$a"; d=$(fm "$f" | sed -n 's/^disallowedTools: //p'); for t in Write Edit; do printf '%s' "$d" | grep -qw "$t" || printf 'BAD-allows-%s:%s ' "$t" "$a"; done; done; printf 'ok'

cases.name: the repo-orkeon rules exist and carry paths: on Orkeon's real layout
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; R="$P/repo-orkeon/claude/rules"; for r in 'orkeon-domain:src/core/Orkeon.Domain/**' 'orkeon-application:src/core/Orkeon.Application/**' 'orkeon-application:src/core/Orkeon.Infrastructure/**' 'orkeon-tests:tests/**/Orkeon.*.Tests/**'; do n=${r%%:*}; p=${r#*:}; f="$R/$n.md"; [ -f "$f" ] || { printf 'BAD-missing:%s ' "$n"; continue; }; [ "$(head -n 1 "$f")" = '---' ] && sed -n '2p' "$f" | grep -qx 'paths:' || printf 'BAD-nopaths:%s ' "$n"; awk 'NR>2 && /^---$/ {exit} NR>2' "$f" | grep -qxF "  - \"$p\"" || printf 'BAD-layout:%s ' "$n"; grep -q '{{' "$f" && printf 'BAD-placeholder:%s ' "$n"; done; printf 'ok'

no dev skill, reference or agent asks the model to write out its reasoning

cases.name: the audit gate passes a closed batch and writes the capture; an open TDD line, an unclassified id or a stray file fail it, with no capture
cases.cmd:
P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; g="$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-verify/scripts/audit-capture.sh"; r="$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-plan/references/design-rules.md"; d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-devgate-{{SID}}-XXXXXX"); cd "$d" && git init -q . && git config user.email e@e && git config user.name e && mkdir -p src tests todo/feat && echo a > src/a.cs && git add src && git commit -qm init && echo 'todo/' >> .git/info/exclude && ids=$(grep -oE '^\| (DDD|APP|PERF)-[0-9]+' "$r" | tr -d '| ' | grep -vx 'DDD-01' | paste -sd, -); printf '# FEAT-PLAN
- **Non-applicable rules**: %s
' "$ids" > todo/feat/FEAT-PLAN.md; printf '# FEAT-PLAN-F1
| Applied rules | DDD-01 |
TDD: RED [x] GREEN [x] COST [x]
' > todo/feat/FEAT-PLAN-F1.md; echo b >> src/a.cs; echo t > tests/aTests.cs; bash "$g" F1 todo/feat/FEAT-PLAN-F1.md "$d/cap1.txt" --build true --roots 'src tests' >/dev/null 2>&1; a=$?; c=$(grep -c '^=== ' "$d/cap1.txt" 2>/dev/null); sed -i 's/COST \[x\]/COST [ ]/' todo/feat/FEAT-PLAN-F1.md; bash "$g" F1 todo/feat/FEAT-PLAN-F1.md "$d/cap2.txt" --roots 'src tests' >/dev/null 2>&1; b=$?; sed -i 's/COST \[ \]/COST [x]/; s/DDD-01/none/' todo/feat/FEAT-PLAN-F1.md; o=$(bash "$g" F1 todo/feat/FEAT-PLAN-F1.md "$d/cap3.txt" --roots 'src tests' 2>/dev/null); e=$?; case "$o" in *'DDD-01'*) i=named ;; *) i=unnamed ;; esac; sed -i 's/none/DDD-01/' todo/feat/FEAT-PLAN-F1.md; echo x > stray.txt; bash "$g" F1 todo/feat/FEAT-PLAN-F1.md "$d/cap4.txt" --roots 'src tests' >/dev/null 2>&1; s=$?; r="green=$a sections=$c open=$b id=$e/$i stray=$s caps=$(ls "$d" | grep -c '^cap')"; cd / && rm -rf "$d"; [ "$r" = 'green=0 sections=5 open=1 id=1/named stray=1 caps=1' ] && printf 'ok' || printf 'BAD-%s' "$r"

cases.name: learn-candidates reads the GAPS rows of the verdict files, folds `Stale plan` onto Plan, and remembers what was treated and refused
cases.cmd:
P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; l="$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-learn/scripts/learn-candidates.py"; d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-devlearn-{{SID}}-XXXXXX"); mkdir -p "$d/todo/feat" "$d/todo/other"; printf '# FEAT-VERIFY-F1

## Verdict \342\200\224 GAPS

| Severity | Axis | Gap | Evidence | Expected fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Blocking | Correctness | empty input | `a.cs:1` | handle it |
| Major | Stale plan: sheet | sheet stale | `F1.md:3` | update it |
| Minor | Simplification | a branch | `a.cs:2` | drop it |
' > "$d/todo/feat/FEAT-VERIFY-F1.md"; sed 's/F1/F2/g; s/empty input/negative input/' "$d/todo/feat/FEAT-VERIFY-F1.md" > "$d/todo/other/OTHER-VERIFY-F2.md"; printf '# OTHER-VERIFY-F3

## Verdict \342\200\224 VALID

| Severity | Axis | Gap | Evidence | Expected fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Major | Plan | not a gap of a GAPS verdict | x | y |
' > "$d/todo/other/OTHER-VERIFY-F3.md"; export DEV_LEARN_ROOT="$d" DEV_LEARN_STATE="$d/state.json"; c1=$(python3 "$l" --count); p=$(python3 "$l" --axis Plan | grep -c '^- \[Major\]'); python3 "$l" --treat-axis Plan; python3 "$l" --refuse 'motif x'; s=$(python3 "$l"); p2=$(python3 "$l" --axis Plan | grep -c '^- '); case "$c1" in '4 untreated verdict gap(s) across 2 batches'*) c=ok ;; *) c="bad[$c1]" ;; esac; case "$s" in *'2 untreated gap(s), 2 batch(es)'*'- motif x'*) t=ok ;; *) t=bad ;; esac; r="count=$c plan=$p after=$p2 summary=$t"; rm -rf "$d"; [ "$r" = 'count=ok plan=2 after=0 summary=ok' ] && printf 'ok' || printf 'BAD-%s' "$r"

cases.name: the dev literals match on both sides (FROZEN-LITERALS.md § 1): the closing line /dev-implement and /dev-verify print is the one dev-batch-guard scans for, and the headings dev-auditor and adversarial-reviewer return are the ones /dev-verify and /dev-spec read
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; L='Batch F1 complete — manual validation required.'; bad=; for f in "$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-implement/SKILL.md" "$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-verify/SKILL.md"; do grep -qF '→ Batch F<n> complete — manual validation required.' "$f" || bad="$bad closing:${f##*/skills/}"; done; pat=$(sed -n 's/.*scan("\(Batch (F\[0-9\]+) complete — manual validation required\)").*/\1/p' {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/dev-batch-guard.sh | sed 's/(F\[0-9\]+)/F[0-9]+/'); { [ -n "$pat" ] && printf '%s' "$L" | grep -qE "$pat"; } || bad="$bad hook-pattern"; for pair in "dev-auditor.md:dev-verify:## Audit — " "adversarial-reviewer.md:dev-spec:## Review — "; do a=${pair%%:*}; r=${pair#*:}; s=${r%%:*}; h=${r#*:}; grep -qF "$h" "$P/dev/claude/agents/$a" || bad="$bad emit:$a"; grep -qF "$h" "$P/dev/claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md" || bad="$bad read:$s"; done; [ -z "$bad" ] && printf ok || printf 'BAD-%s' "$bad"
